label: Best months
value: Summer only; the lake is accessible only during summer
quote: Kundol Lake is accessible only during summer.

label: Hike from Laddu (other reports)
value: About 4 to 6 hours of hiking from Ladu to the lake (Kiddle encyclopedia mirror; weak source)
quote: From Ladu, it takes about four to six hours of hiking to reach Kundol Lake.

label: Hike time, river bridge
value: 3 to 4 hours from the river bridge to the lake, by Pakistan Highlands
quote: It can be a 3 to 4 hours’ trek from the river bridge to the Kandol Lake.

label: The road
value: Jeeps once reached Laddu village; in a June 2013 report they went only a couple of km past Utror
quote: Earlier, jeeps used to go till Laddu Village but these days only a couple of km ahead of Utror

label: Jeep time
value: About an hour from Kalam to Utror by a privately hired jeep
quote: It takes about an hour from Kalam to Utror by a privately hired jeep.

label: Before you go
value: The Laddu bridge was broken in June 2013; check the crossing before you start
quote: The bridge to Laddu is broken.
source: PakWheels trip report, June 2013 (dated; check current status)
